title: Existing IB/IC minimum engine power
regulation_text: In order to retain ice class IB or IC a ship, to which ice class regulations 1985 apply, shall comply with the required minimum engine output as defined in section 3.2.1 of the ice class regulations 1985. The engine output shall be no less than that determined by the formula below and in no case less than 740 kW for ice classes IB and IC.
